scope: Preserves the existing sampled vertical roof-clearance criterion for the unchanged six fish routes; not a new whole-body or continuous collision certificate.
argument: For any fixed (x,z), pure downward translation leaves the target footprint fixed and changes its highest vertical intersection height T to T-delta. Every other terrain height O is unchanged, so max(O,T-delta) <= max(O,T). Therefore unchanged fish-center height minus sampled roof cannot decrease at any previously checked footprint point. The same five-point footprint checks remain no worse under this isolated change.
preserved_existing_check: qa-life.mjs checks fish center plus x/z offsets [±0.22,0] and [0,±0.22] against highest triangle roof every 0.5 simulated seconds within its 164-second sampled run. This does not certify articulated full-body swept collision.
historical_scope: Sampled geometry/kinematic checks, not continuous collision proof or biological validation
historical_numeric_caveat: The historical report does not embed its geometry source hash; its numbers are reference values, not newly measured current-pose minima. The monotonicity statement applies to the isolated old-pose/new-pose comparison independent of those values.
